reviews.text: They don’t like pit bulls and say they will let my dog stay then say last minute she can’t stay. Terrible service.

I'm so happy my baby (dog) daddy found this place for us I was very pleased with the service I'm  officially making VIP dog hotel service my baby groomer I love the way he cut his hair I have been trying to achieve that style for my baby for a long time it's just seem like the other groomers couldn't pull it off he definitely did it the way I've been wanting it to look like the atmosphere loved it very friendly very understanding and most important of all very patient with my baby cuz I know he can be a handful at times so yes I'm definitely giving it all five gold stars and I'm definitely going to recommend it to my friends and families that have pets as well to visit!!! And last but not least I have a miniature schnauzer!!!🤗👍👍👍

Have used VIP Dog Hotel three times. The first time was only because my regular boarding was booked up. My dogs absolutely love it here. The owners are really nice. My dogs love them and get excited to see them when we drop them off. I’ve fully moved my dogs here for all their boarding needs. Coming back twice for September dates.
VIP Dog Hotel is a great place for dogs. Owners were friendly & caring.
This place is great!!
Friendly! Great place and affordable.  My bingo was so happy here.
Took our puppy in for grooming and it was a great experience for him and us. Super happy

We’ve had such a great experience with this dog boarding facility! Marcelo and his team consistently provide outstanding customer service—they’re friendly, attentive, and genuinely care about the dogs in their care.

Our dog absolutely loves going there, which gives us so much peace of mind whenever we’re away. It’s clear they treat every dog like family, and that level of care really stands out. We always feel confident knowing our pup is in such good hands. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a trustworthy and caring place for their dog!

I’ve been bringing my Doberman Rosie here for over two years. she’s very energetic and can be a handful, but I can always depend on Marcelo to take care of her and gives her the attention she needs. They’re very friendly and Rosie is always excited to come here and stay for a few days. Thanks for everything! Also their grooming is awesome she comes home very clean and happy.
A great place to take your pets to get groomed 👌🏾👍🏾👍🏾👍🏾👍🏾

We absolutely love this place for grooming our doodle. Marcelo and his wife actually love what they do and don't shame you if you bring in a doodle like most groomers, lol. They're kind and helpful and make you feel taken care of. Show this small business some love! You'll be so happy you did.

We brought our Trinitee here yesterday for a puppy grooming and they did am AMAZING job. We are so pleased with how they are so welcoming and treated our girl so well. We will definitely be back. Thank you so much!
On Short notice they accepted to board my two dogs and they did an amazing job

Our neighbor suggested this place. Our pup Benedict can be a handful to say the least so we were hesitant to leave him anywhere. From the very start, Marcelo made us feel at ease with his knowledge and we can tell our pup is very comfortable around him. The place is clean and spacious. The staff is very professional. We feel confident knowing our fur baby is in good hands.

I used Vip Dog Hotel for the first time and it was a great experience. My baby made new friends and didn't want to leave! We will be back!

Thank you for taking care of my baby Marcello!
I leave my elderly beagle and shitzu here every time we go out of town. They usually don’t want to leave so I know Marcelo and his team take good care of them.

Marcelo and the team always takes care of my two schnauzers REALLY well. This is honestly the only daycare/boarding you can rest assured your dog will be taken care of well. I had them stay for more than 30 days now, and every single time they come home happy and wanting to go back!

Thank you Marcelo

This is the best doggy daycare.  My pomeranian, Toby is always excited when I drop him off, I think he likes the daycare better than home, LOL.  If you are looking for a daycare for your fur baby, please check this one out.  I have tried other daycares before I found VIP Dog Hotel, and Toby was getting sick or overwhelmed.  We have not had any issues at VIP Dog Hotel since we found them 6 months ago.
Excellent attention and excellent service :) THANK YOU!!!

One of our apartment’s residents recommended Best Doggy Daycare, so we brought our puppy here for boarding. He came back home happy, healthy, and smelling amazing. Better than any dog hotel, boarding service or app out there. Owners and staff are impeccable and good people. Thank you! 😊 …

Brought my dog here while I had to go out of town for a few days. The place was very clean. I got picture updates on my dog. I know that my dog was in good hands. The groomer gave my dog a good bath and deshed before we picked him up.

I brought my beloved furry friend to BEST Doggy Daycare, Hotel, Groomer and I cannot recommend it enough. The staff is incredibly caring and professional, providing top-notch care for all the dogs in their facility. The facilities are clean and spacious, with plenty of room for the dogs to play and socialize.
Great place to bring your dog. He offers Daycare and overnight stays. As well as grooming. Gives your fur babies some new friends to play with during the day while you are away.
Excellent telephone service.

We were from out of town and he was so understanding and had no issues with time for pick up and drop off of our fur baby.  Our fur baby was worn out from running and playing with the other dogs.  I would definitely use him again when we visit Dallas next year.

Thank you for caring for our precious fur baby.

This place is amazing! I had someone who was going to watch my fur baby while I went out of town to be with my mother when my aunt passed away when just hours before my flight was scheduled to leave my committed doggie sitter canceled. I probably called over 30 places with no luck for last minute boarding until my brother found this Gem just minutes from my home. Marcelo made everything so easy for me. I was updated regularly on my baby’s care. This truly is the best doggie daycare and boarding hands down! Bajei stayed 5 days and is looking forward to going regularly to play with his new friends at The best Doggie Daycare in town.
A+ they did so great for me and my friends dogs. Would def use again. ❤️💪🏽 …
